nations.name: Trinidad Rancheria
also: Cher-Ae Heights Indian Community of the Trinidad Rancheria
nations.lands: Near Trinidad, Humboldt County, northern California

facts.text: The Rancheria’s history dates congressional land-purchase authority to 1906 and a purchase for coastal Native people to 1908.
The Council page dates organization under Articles of Association to 1961 and approval of a superseding Constitution to June 2008.
facts.evidence: In June of 2008, the Tribe approved

facts.text: The Cultural Resources page names language and cultural preservation as priorities and describes cultural education partnerships with other tribes.
facts.evidence: Preservation of language and cultural traditions

facts.text: The Environmental Program reports that the Tribe replaced the pier in 2012 with an infiltration system designed to collect and divert stormwater runoff.
